Bug_Details:
Variable assigned to itself The left-hand side and right-hand side of this assignment are the same. It has
no effect. This also handles assignments in which the right-hand side is a call to
Preconditions.checkNotNull(), which returns the variable that was checked for
non-nullity. If you just intended to check that the variable is non-null, please
don’t assign the result to the checked variable; just call
Preconditions.checkNotNull() as a bare statement.
Bug_Explanation: The variable 'x' is assigned to itself, which has no effect.
Trigger_Explanation: The testSelfAssignmentBug method calls the showBug method, which contains the buggy line 'x = x;'. This line has no effect, but the test case expects the output to be 'Value of x after self assignment: 10'. Since the bug causes the output to remain unchanged, the assertion in the test case fails, triggering the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test execution results show that all tests passed (OK (1 test)). This means that the expected output 'Value of x after self assignment: 10' matches the actual output, indicating that the bug was not triggered.
